phrases.note: The Ẹ shows respect. Use it with parents, grandparents and anyone older. To a friend, just say “Káàárọ̀”.
The respectful “thank you”. To someone your age or younger, say “O ṣé”.
A warm way to ask after an elder’s health. They may answer “Àlàáfíà ni” — all is well.

check.correctFeedback: Correct! Ẹ ṣé is the respectful “thank you”.
check.wrongFeedback: Not quite. “Thank you” is Ẹ ṣé. You’ll see it again soon.
